top_signals.title: US Stocks Waver Near Record as Oil Retreats Ahead of Inflation
top_signals.summary: US stocks were trading between gains and losses in early trading Tuesday, as oil swung back and forth while traders await key inflation data that could shape the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate policy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Chobani Cuts Annual Earnings Forecast on Rising Material Costs
top_signals.summary: Chobani has lowered its annual earnings forecast as the Greek yogurt maker contends with rising material costs, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Anthropic strikes $9B compute deal with Bitcoin miner Riot: Report
top_signals.summary: Anthropic reportedly struck a $9 billion deal with Riot for 191 megawatts of capacity from the Bitcoin miner’s Rockdale campus in Texas.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
